name: TV Collage Crewneck — Washed Black
description:
A zine-style collage of old TV screens and grainy panels under a serif FINAL HEAVEN heading on the front. Embroidered mark at the front hem.

Heavyweight washed cotton with a snow-wash finish, relaxed unisex fit. The three-star mark is embroidered. Printed to order, and the wash makes every one slightly different.

supplier.name: Suning Sufang Yazhi Clothing Co., Ltd.

source.notes: Blank crewneck ¥40 (owner, 8 Nov), same shop as the hoodies; the crewneck has its own listing, link not given yet (hoodie link used). Print and embroidery cost not included. Price = ₦30,000 base + ₦5,000 for the embroidered mark (owner rule). Sizes S–XL assumed. Photo generated on the real blank. Design: brand/designs/concepts-11.
